final: WITH fee_side AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.dealedge AS side, f.feerate AS feerate, f.rebrate AS rebrate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009), grp AS (SELECT orderslink, side, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fee_side GROUP BY orderslink, side), side_avg AS (SELECT side, AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS side_avg FROM grp GROUP BY side) SELECT g.orderslink, g.side, g.avg_net_fee_rate, g.record_count, g.avg_net_fee_rate - s.side_avg AS diff_from_side_avg FROM grp g JOIN side_avg s ON s.side IS g.side WHERE g.avg_net_fee_rate > s.side_avg ORDER BY (g.avg_net_fee_rate - s.side_avg IS NULL), diff_from_side_avg DESC LIMIT 10
